blocks.text: B cells bhi bone marrow mein bante hain lekin T cells ke bar-aks yeh pukhta hone ke liye thymus nahin jate. Yeh apni pukhtagi bone marrow hi mein mukammal karte hain. Wahan se yeh khoon aur lymph mein gardish ke liye chhor diye jate hain. T cells ki tarah har B cell bhi khaas antigens pehchanne ka mahir hota hai. Jab B cell ka kisi antigen se saamna hota hai to yeh taqseem ho kar bohat se naye cells banata hai jinhein plasma cells kehte hain. Har plasma cell aisi antibody banata hai jo antigen se chipak jati hai aur us par tabahi ka nishan laga deti hai.

blocks.prompt: T cells aur B cells kahan bante aur kahan pukhta hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Dono bone marrow ke stem cells se bante hain. T cells thymus mein ja kar pukhta hote hain; B cells bone marrow hi mein pukhta hote hain.

items: Immune system ke cells white blood cells hain jo bone marrow mein bante aur khoon aur lymph mein gardish karte hain.
Monocytes macrophages aur doosre phagocytes bante hain; helper T cells ko fa'al karne wale proteins banate hain.
T cells thymus mein pukhta: helper, cytotoxic, inducer, suppressor.
B cells bone marrow mein pukhta; antigen milne par plasma cells bante hain jo antibodies banate hain.
